description: Fundamentals of computer graphics; geometric modeling of solids and curved surfaces of mechanical parts; part and assembly drawing generation; integrated CAD/CAE/CAM system for modelling, simulation, analysis using FEA and CFD, CNC tool path generation and design optimization; input and output of CAD systems, data management and customization of CAD/CAE/CAM systems.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of:
    • MECH200 - Engineering Drawing, CAD and Manufacturing (1.5)
    • MECH200A - Introduction to Technical Drawing and Computer Aided Design (1.5)
    • BME350 - Biomedical Engineering Design (2.0)
    • ECE299 - Introduction to Electrical and Computer Engineering Design (1.5)
    • ELEC299 - Introduction to Electrical and Computer Engineering Design (1.5)
preOrCorequisites:
• Completed or concurrently enrolled in all of:
    • CSC349A - Numerical Analysis (1.5)
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 410, MECH 520.
  • May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
title: Computer-Aided Design and Engineering
